newsitem.title: USA: TCI to use some cash flow for debt, stock.
newsitem.headline: TCI to use some cash flow for debt, stock.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said Friday it plans to use its longer-term free cash flow to reduce its debt and to buy back its stock and invest in opportunities.
"This year the company has made great strides in enhancing its financial flexibility," TCI chairman and chief executive officer John Malone said in a news release.
In addition to plans for longer-term free cash flow, Malone said, "We remain committed to using our near-term free cash flow to reduce our leverage ratio to a level below 5.0 times."
The company defines free cash flow as operating cash flow minus interest, capital expenditures and preferred dividends, it said.

The company Friday reported its cable operations' second quarter free cash flow was $282 million on operating cash flow of $706 milion. It did not provide comparative figures and a company spokesman was not available for comment.
